summary: Launch event for St Lucia from the founding Act, found by the launch-post fact check (decision 14: the day applications opened is its own event).

events.title: Citizenship by Investment Act 2015 (No. 14 of 2015) dated 24 August 2015
events.description: Founding Act of the St Lucia programme. The date is the one printed under the long title; the Act has no separate commencement section (METHODOLOGY decision 14: launched = in-force date, else the date the text gives). Assented 17 August 2015; regulations SI 89 of 2015 dated 2 October 2015; applications opened 1 January 2016 (separate event).
events.location: PDF p. 3, heading under the long title
